title: Diagonal quasi-isomorphisms of Roos coordinate complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $V,V^{\prime},L,L^{\prime}$ be cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $s:V\to V$, $s^{\prime}:V^{\prime}\to V^{\prime}$ chain endomorphisms. Suppose specified isomorphisms identify $L^i=V^i\oplus V^{i-1}$ and $L^{\prime i}=V^{\prime i}\oplus V^{\prime i-1}$ with differential $(x,y)\mapsto(dx,sx-dy)$ in both cases. If $a:V\to V^{\prime}$ is a quasi-isomorphism and a chain map $f:L\to L^{\prime}$ acts in these coordinates by $(a^i,a^{i-1})$, then $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08TC, definition-derived-limit: mapping fiber model; elementary mapping-cone comparison expanded by D9

proof.text: Include V shifted by minus one as the second coordinate and project L onto the first coordinate. The displayed differential makes these chain maps and gives a short exact sequence split in each degree. Do the same for the primed data. The coordinate formula on f supplies a morphism of these short exact sequences, with outer arrows a shifted by minus one and a. Shift preserves quasi-isomorphisms, so the two outer arrows are quasi-isomorphisms. Apply the five lemma to the long exact homology sequences, equivalently HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.quasiIso_τ₂ from the source library, to conclude that f is a quasi-isomorphism.

theorem quasiIso_of_roos_coordinates
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    (V V' L L' : CochainComplex A ℤ) (s : V ⟶ V) (s' : V' ⟶ V')
    (e : ∀ i : ℤ, L.X i ≅ V.X i ⊞ V.X (i - 1))
    (e' : ∀ i : ℤ, L'.X i ≅ V'.X i ⊞ V'.X (i - 1))
    (hd : ∀ i : ℤ, L.d i (i + 1) ≫ (e (i + 1)).hom =
      (e i).hom ≫ biprod.lift (biprod.fst ≫ V.d i (i + 1))
        (biprod.fst ≫ s.f i ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg V.X (Int.add_sub_cancel i 1).symm) -
          biprod.snd ≫ V.d (i - 1) ((i + 1) - 1)))
    (hd' : ∀ i : ℤ, L'.d i (i + 1) ≫ (e' (i + 1)).hom =
      (e' i).hom ≫ biprod.lift (biprod.fst ≫ V'.d i (i + 1))
        (biprod.fst ≫ s'.f i ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg V'.X (Int.add_sub_cancel i 1).symm) -
          biprod.snd ≫ V'.d (i - 1) ((i + 1) - 1)))
    (a : V ⟶ V') (f : L ⟶ L')
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, f.f i ≫ (e' i).hom =
      (e i).hom ≫ biprod.map (a.f i) (a.f (i - 1)))
    (ha : QuasiIso a) : QuasiIso f
